verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jitsu Functions can be built and deployed from a user's own repo with jitsu-cli, and that an audit log exists. Neither is a documented Jitsu capability for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations: versioning and review would come from the user's own git setup, and an audit log is an adjacent control, not version history or rollback. No first-party version history, diff/review, or rollback feature for functions or pipeline configuration is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
